verdict.rationale: cubic documents several first-party export paths in open formats: CSV export of analytics team data, a PR-level Analytics API, AI wiki export as markdown files into the repo, and configuration kept in a repo-resident cubic.yaml. Nothing documents an 'export all data' capability covering review findings, comment history, or learned memories, and nothing covers account offboarding or deletion. missing for 10: comprehensive all-data export (review findings, comment history, learnings/memory), documented account deletion/offboarding process, independent corroboration of export completeness

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: You can export team member data as CSV from both
cubic exports the wiki as markdown files into a directory in your repo (default `.cubic/wiki`)
The Analytics API gives you PR-level data on how many issues were flagged, how many were fixed, how much AI code was authored
`cubic.yaml` lives in the root of your repository and becomes the source of truth for AI review behavior, ignore patterns, PR descriptions, and custom agents.
